presentation.rationale: A foundation-tier home for four pure data/exception types; there is no UI surface at any tier.

redistributedComplexity: every producer (Layout, Calendar, Rules in blocks; Documents in foundation) would go back to reimplementing its own stage vocabulary and refusal shape, exactly the T-583-vs-T-757 divergence this module exists to close

Documents could not reach the shared envelope at all without crossing the foundation->blocks tier fence that hlp.architecture.tests enforces, forcing its own string-stage TemplateAdmissionException back into existence
